amendment.reason: pre-execution clean-worktree gate defect on local execution artifacts (runs/**, cache/**)

execution_order.policy: deterministic balanced four-condition rotation by frozen case index

generator.prompt_contract: current frozen WesternEvidenceAgent SYSTEM_PROMPT and generation prompt unchanged

headline_retrieval_denominator.policy: supported or partially_supported cases with non-empty primary gold; all insufficient cases reported separately

protocol_freeze_commit: populated from immutable repository HEAD at run creation; not self-embedded in this hash

provenance_metrics.name: provenance_integrity_rate
provenance_metrics.scope: application-level provenance membership and resolution; not sentence-level citation correctness

raw_output_policy: new run_id for every repeat; never overwrite a run or sealed stage; runs/** and cache/** are local execution artifacts ignored by Git; excerpt-bearing Stage A raw results remain local and hash-referenced

research_questions.W-RQ1: How do retrieval strategies affect gold-evidence retrieval within the frozen MediRAG-West pilot corpus?
research_questions.W-RQ2: With the generator held fixed, how do retrieval strategies affect evidence coverage and unsupported-claim behavior in generated Western pilot answers?
research_questions.W-RQ3: How does the system behave when the frozen pilot corpus provides incomplete or insufficient evidence?

R2.implementation: RetrievalEngine reciprocal-rank fusion of lexical and dense rankings

R3.implementation: RetrievalEngine hybrid RRF candidates followed by remote reranking

scientific_scope: Performance only within the frozen 16-source, 271-chunk Western pilot corpus; not general medical or clinical competence.

stage_a_missingness_policy.insufficient_cases: remain outside primary-gold Recall/MRR when primary gold is empty; technical failures are reported as missingness, never abstention or correctness
stage_a_missingness_policy.pairwise_denominator: intersection of frozen gold-eligible cases where both compared conditions have retrieval_success=true; report exact paired n; no imputation
stage_a_missingness_policy.quality_denominator: for each condition, frozen primary-gold eligible cases with retrieval_success=true; technical failures are excluded, not scored as zero

stage_a_terminal_and_sealing_policy.seal_requires: 192 unique terminal cells and no fatal runner defect, corrupt checkpoint, duplicate, in-progress cell, or frozen-input mismatch

stage_a_upstream_missingness_policy.generation: retain the experiment cell but do not call Qwen; record generation_outcome=upstream_retrieval_technical_failure, empty answer/provenance, zero provider attempts and zero generation latency
stage_a_upstream_missingness_policy.interpretation: upstream technical missingness is neither abstention, insufficiency handling, content failure, nor generator/judge failure
stage_a_upstream_missingness_policy.judge: retain the experiment cell but do not call GLM; record judge_outcome=upstream_retrieval_technical_failure, no semantic labels, zero provider attempts and zero judge latency

stages.A: retrieval only; independently finalized and sealed output is immutable Stage B input
stages.B: generation only from sealed Stage A; sealed output is immutable Stage C input
stages.C: judge only from sealed Stage A and B outputs

statistical_plan.paired_bounded: paired differences with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals where implemented
statistical_plan.report: exact sample sizes; do not overemphasize p-values

technical_retry_policy.attempt_count_definition: cell-level: 1 means no retry event; 2 means one permitted retry event
technical_retry_policy.retry_scope: one retry event per formal cell; R1/R2 retry dense only; R3 retries only the failed dense or reranker operation and never repeats a successful dense provider operation
